A [[Color/Legends|red]]-bladed '''lightsaber''' belonged to the Lord of Pain, [[Darth Sion]]. Sion used the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to [[Cho mai/Legends|amputate]] [[Kreia]], who was formerly his [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] Darth Traya, in [[3951 BBY]].<ref name="KOTOR II" />

Later that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Sion would wield this lightsaber in a [[Duel in the Korriban Academy (First Jedi Purge)|duel]] against Jedi Exile [[Meetra Surik]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], and later against her [[Battle of Malachor|once more]] on [[Malachor V]] where he met his [[Death/Legends|demise]].<ref name="KOTOR II" />
